purpose: Define a new prospective response-blind geometry after the v0.12 250x40 classifiability stop, using only the already frozen aggregate classifiability fact that every frozen species has at least 15 evaluable records. No species-specific classifiability count, colour vector, pairwise colour distance, or empirical TTF statistic may be used to define this design.

forbidden_before_v13_synthetic_requalifi: Jensen-Shannon or other pairwise colour distances

geometry_gate.retained_record_selection: Among evaluable records within each frozen species, select the 15 smallest SHA256 keys of '20260926\x1f' + photo_id. This selection uses no colour value.

actual_geometry_architecture.species_split: reuse exactly the v0.11/v0.12 125/125 species split; do not redraw
actual_geometry_architecture.execution_operator: same Gaussian opportunity-corrected segment-integrated transfer operator family as v0.11/v0.12, with k changed prospectively to 2 because 0.15 x 15 = 2.25 and the frozen integer neighbor count is two
actual_geometry_architecture.training_response: same frozen training-side edge-length orthogonalized turnover

synthetic_requalification.pass_rule: maximum Wilson 95% upper bound across the four private cells <= 0.10 AND Wilson 95% lower bound for shared A2 >= 0.80
synthetic_requalification.if_fail: Freeze failure and stop empirical TTF. Do not tune k, bandwidth, record count, species membership, profiling, thresholds, or synthetic cells on this geometry.
synthetic_requalification.if_pass: Only then may a separately authorized empirical TTF run read the frozen colour representation for these exact 3,750 retained records.

claim_boundary: A v0.13 synthetic pass would establish only adequacy of the predeclared 250x15 actual geometry. It would not establish an empirical shared flower-colour boundary, prevalence, cause, history, or pollinator mechanism.
